第2阶段（第3至第10个月）：信号与监控预埋套管、灯具基础及接地施工，分段围封推进，隐蔽工程记录同步闭环。
第3阶段（第8至第16个月）：道路照明灯具安装与系统调试、交通标志安装、标线施划，按路段完成面移交顺序滚动施工。
第4阶段（第14至第22个月）：绿化种植、附属设施安装，进入养护期管理。
第5阶段（第22至第24个月）：系统联调、质量验收记录汇总、竣工资料移交与养护期交接。

资源安排：本包资源需求0.7，我方资源账2.0全部空闲，具备独立承担的组织与人力基础；标线、照明调试、绿化养护班组可用性以内部可用性摘要确认，必要时以专项分包补足，作为投标假设管理。

接口协调：与土建包按周召开接口协调会，交接点以书面清单签署，标高与预埋归属争议在工序前解决，不留到收面后返工。
bid_document.schedule_commitment: 总工期24个月，与项目整体工期一致。关键节点：第3个月完成接口交接清单签署与临时改道方案报批；第10个月完成信号与监控预埋及照明基础；第16个月完成照明调试与标线施划；第22个月完成绿化种植并进入养护期；第24个月完成系统联调、验收记录移交与养护交接。与土建包接口按路段完成面移交顺序滚动衔接，接口交接点以书面清单签署后进入下一工序。
bid_document.compliance_statement: 接受业主及成本顾问的造价审查，报价按设计方接口工程量归属说明统一报价基础，预埋与收面工作计入本包范围并单独列明，不与土建包重复计列路基、路面结构与排水主体工程量。报价已反映材料价格指数约1.05与人工价格指数约1.10，并预留偏保守风险准备。质量验收记录由我方自有体系闭环，接受业主过程检查与隐蔽工程验收；接口交接清单与验收记录签署责任建议由我方施工经理与土建包对应负责人共同签署，业主或监理见证。分包边界在交付方案中明确，分包不改变我方单一责任主体地位。
bid_document.risk_response:
主要风险及应对：
1. 接口工程量归属风险：按设计方接口说明锁定报价基础，设书面交接清单与标高复核点，工序前解决归属争议，报价中预留接口返工准备。
2. 材料与人工价格上行：报价已按材料指数约1.05、人工约1.10计入，风险准备按偏保守口径预留，不靠压薄准备换单价。
3. 专业班组可用性待核实：标线、照明调试、绿化养护班组以内部可用性摘要确认，必要时专项分包补足，作为投标假设管理并据此留风险准备。
4. 既有路网交通改道与公众沟通：分段围封加临时改道，公众说明排入工序，设交通协管。
5. 监管审批约30天等待与0.3程序不确定性：提前启动报批，文件版本号冻结并按章节交叉核对后提交。
6. 质量记录闭环：隐蔽工程记录、材料进场验收与独立复核三条线闭环，接口处先定责任再排工序。

negotiated_clauses.scope_and_interfaces: 承包人（COMP-0494）以单一责任主体身份承担本包全部授权范围：交通标志标线、信号与监控预埋、道路照明安装与调试、绿化种植及养护、附属设施施工，并负责本包材料自行采购与本包质量验收记录。与土建包在路面完成面标高及预埋管线接口处交接：预埋套管、灯具基础与收面配合计入本包，路基、路面结构与排水主体工程量归土建包，不重复计列。接口交接以书面交接清单签署及标高复核为进入下一工序的前置条件；接口工程量归属争议须在相应工序开始前解决。承包人须于开工前提交标线、照明调试、绿化养护三类专项班组的落实计划与人员到位时间表（含分包意向或可用性摘要），经业主审核通过后方可开工；未通过审核不得进入相应工序。分包不改变承包人单一责任主体地位，审查不通过时由承包人自行补足，不构成价格或工期调整事由。
negotiated_clauses.price_and_change_control: 合同价格为固定总价40,250,000 MOP（币种MOP），涵盖本包全部授权范围，包括三类专项班组落实与分包管理、接口返工准备、约30天监管审批等待及0.3程序不确定性；上述事项均作为承包人承担的风险分配，不另行计价，不设价格调整机制。材料价格指数约1.05与人工价格指数约1.10已计入报价，业主接受为风险分配。任何超出授权范围的价格或工期调整均须经业主书面变更指令；本稿不授权任何未列明的价格调整，若后续请求涉及价格、币种、范围、成员或资源承诺变更，该事项保持未决并须重新招标。

negotiated_clauses.delivery_and_review: 总工期24个月，与项目整体工期一致。关键节点：第3个月完成接口交接清单签署与临时改道方案报批；第10个月完成信号与监控预埋及照明基础；第16个月完成照明调试与标线施划；第22个月完成绿化种植并进入养护期；第24个月完成系统联调、验收记录移交与养护交接。承包人须于开工前提交三类专项班组落实计划与人员到位时间表供业主审核，审核通过为开工及相应里程碑付款的前置条件。与土建包按路段完成面移交顺序滚动衔接，按周召开接口协调会，交接点以书面清单签署。隐蔽工程记录、材料进场验收与独立复核三条线闭环；分段围封加临时改道并设交通协管，公众说明排入工序。

terms.scope: 仅为施工包「A区东轴线交通配套、照明与绿化工程包」供应其施工所需的材料与构配件：供货、运输到场、质量证明文件和质保期内的更换。不含任何施工、安装、临时工程或措施费，也不承担施工界面责任。材料费用已包含在该施工包的合同价内，由该施工包的承包商作为买方支付。该施工包的工作内容（仅用于判断所需材料，不属于本包工作）：承担路网范围内的交通标志标线、信号与监控预埋、道路照明、绿化种植及附属设施施工；负责本包材料自行采购与本包质量验收记录。与土建包在路面完成面标高及预埋管线接口处交接，不重复计列路基、路面结构与排水主体工程量。

negotiated_clauses.scope_and_interfaces: COMP-0154 supplies only the four material categories for construction package CASE-0006/construction-2 (A区东轴线交通配套、照明与绿化工程包): traffic sign and marking materials, lighting luminaires and fittings, signal and monitoring embedded materials, and greening materials; delivery to site, quality certification documents, and warranty-period replacement are included. No construction, installation, temporary works or measure costs, and no construction interface responsibility. COMP-0154 submits written installation interface information to the buyer (COMP-0494) for the buyer's own installation; the buyer's construction-package quality acceptance records govern acceptance. Material costs remain included in the parent construction package contract price and are paid by COMP-0494 as buyer. Any scope change beyond these four categories remains unresolved and requires re-tendering.
negotiated_clauses.price_and_change_control: Total price 12,350,000 MOP, unchanged, with the bid breakdown preserved: traffic sign and marking materials 2,860,000 MOP (fixed), lighting luminaires and fittings 3,420,000 MOP (fixed), signal and monitoring embedded materials 1,980,000 MOP (fixed), greening materials 2,260,000 MOP (adjustable), transport and logistics 620,000 MOP, quality documents and warranty replacement risk allowance 780,000 MOP, supply management and commercial coordination 430,000 MOP. Before signing, COMP-0154 submits written supplier quotations or supply-intent evidence for the main sub-items of the three fixed-price categories; any fixed-price sub-item without such evidence is treated as a provisional estimate and adjusted to the verified quotation only with the buyer's prior written confirmation. Greening materials are adjustable against material price index 1.112 as baseline; the trigger conditions and calculation method are stated in writing in the contract, and no adjustment takes effect without the buyer's prior written confirmation. Fixed-price items carry the stated risk allowance and do not absorb index increases beyond it; no uncapped price adjustment is added to the authorized scope.
negotiated_clauses.payment_terms: Payment is made in batches against delivery, acceptance and payment per construction-package progress: each batch is paid only after the corresponding quality certification documents and the buyer's site acceptance record are provided, with the acceptance standard being COMP-0494's construction-package quality acceptance record. The warranty period for each batch starts from the date that batch passes acceptance. Payment nodes and acceptance standards are as set out in this clause and require no further document; COMP-0154 confirms them in writing after signing and on that basis locks its sub-supply and delivery commitments.
negotiated_clauses.delivery_and_review: Delivery milestones follow the construction-package schedule: after award COMP-0154 completes the supply plan and submits interface documents; the first batch of traffic sign, marking and embedded materials arrives at the construction-package start node; lighting luminaires arrive in installation batches; greening materials arrive within planting-season windows. Specific arrival dates are those confirmed in the supply milestones by COMP-0494 as construction-package contractor. Before the first delivery, COMP-0154 completes source and lead-time verification. Quality certification documents are submitted per category with each batch, with incoming inspection cooperation and warranty replacement response times as contract annex obligations; warranty replacement is handled by category from each batch's acceptance date.
negotiated_clauses.response_to_feedback: Buyer (COMP-0494) decisions now binding: batch delivery, batch acceptance and batch payment per construction-package progress, paid against quality documents and the buyer's acceptance record, warranty from each batch's acceptance date (feedback item 2 decided, no further document awaited). Accepted as stated risk allocation: the disclosed bid assumptions that sub-supply arrangements and alternative sources are not yet in place, and that fixed-price items carry index exposure within the stated allowance. Converted into obligations: pre-signing supplier quotation evidence for the three fixed-price categories, with unverified sub-items treated as provisional estimates adjusted only on the buyer's written confirmation (item 1); written trigger and calculation for the greening index-1.112 adjustment, effective only on the buyer's written confirmation (item 3); arrival dates per the buyer-confirmed supply milestones with source and lead-time verification before first delivery (item 4). COMP-0154's acceptance is noted. Price, currency, scope boundaries, parties, work shares and resource commitments are unchanged; no external documents or real-world approvals are claimed as reviewed or obtained, and future engineering deliverables remain binding obligations. Either party may reject this draft.

bid_document.technical_proposal:
本公司以单一责任主体身份独立投标本设计包，不组组合体。技术主线为：总体设计确定道路平纵横、交叉口与路网衔接的总体控制条件，并将该控制逻辑贯穿施工图设计与现场设计配合全过程。

一、总体设计：以A区东轴线第1期工程约32,000平方米范围为对象，完成道路总体设计协调、线形与竖向控制、交叉口与周边路网接口梳理，形成总体设计文件与设计输入条件清单，作为施工图深化依据。

二、施工图设计：按分阶段出图节点表推进，先地下后地上、先结构后附属，逐批出图并配套设计输入与接口清单更新。MEP与结构接口协调、BIM碰撞检查按常规专业分包处理，分包范围、审核节点与独立校核安排写入接口清单与投标假设；独立校核由不参与原设计的团队执行，校核意见闭环后方可出图。

三、现场设计配合：设现场设计代表，按施工阶段与出图节点实配人月，按响应时限分级承诺（一般技术澄清、接口冲突、交通改道与社区沟通事项分级处理），不以压价虚减现场投入。

四、交通改道与社区沟通初步设想：按施工分期编制临时交通改道初步方案与社区沟通初步设想，作为专项分包与独立校核对象，纳入接口清单管理。

五、质量目标与验收标准：质量目标与验收标准逐项挂到分阶段出图节点，形成可核查的验收条目。

六、交付物与现场配合人月量化范围表：按施工阶段与出图节点编制，列明各阶段人月数与现场配合人月单价假设，作为分阶段报价基础。该表初稿尚在内部编制，本投标按量化口径与投标假设提交，不写成已核实数据。

5. 收尾与移交：完成竣工图配合、设计变更归档与经验总结，交付物按清单逐项核销。

negotiated_clauses.scope_and_interfaces: 承包人（COMP-0169）以单一责任主体身份承担总体设计、施工图设计与现场设计配合，不组组合体，工作份额100%，资源承诺0.25。范围以A区东轴线第1期工程约32,000平方米为对象：总体设计完成道路平纵横、交叉口与路网衔接控制条件及总体设计文件与设计输入条件清单；施工图设计按分阶段出图节点表分批出图，先地下后地上、先结构后附属；现场设计配合配置现场设计代表。MEP与结构接口、BIM碰撞检查、交通改道与社区沟通三项专项按常规专业分包加独立校核执行，分包范围、审核节点与责任界面写入接口清单，独立校核由不参与原设计的团队执行。每批出图前须提交独立校核闭环记录与接口清单更新版，未闭环不得出图，业主保留逐项核查权。交通改道与社区沟通专项的分级响应时限及公众说明材料提交节点在合同附件中列为可核查义务。
negotiated_clauses.price_and_change_control: 合同价格为固定总价4,150,000 MOP，币种MOP，在450万MOP包预算上限内，按投标分阶段报价基础构成：总体设计780,000；施工图设计1,620,000；MEP与结构接口、BIM碰撞检查专项分包及独立校核520,000；交通改道与社区沟通专项及现场配合人月690,000；质量目标与验收标准编制、文档控制及保险235,000；项目管理、公司管理费及风险预备305,000。交付物与现场配合人月量化范围表定稿后一次性替换分阶段报价基础数字，不改变报价口径、不虚减现场配合人月，且替换结果不得突破4,150,000 MOP；替换结果经双方书面确认后仅作为支付分摊与进度核验依据，不触发价格调整。人月表未定稿、三项专项人力待核实、专项分包成本为投标估算等已披露投标假设，作为承包人承担的风险分配，不构成价格调整事由。超出上述范围的新增工作不纳入本合同固定总价，属未决事项，需重新招标。

negotiated_clauses.scope_and_interfaces: COMP-0154 supplies only the four material categories for construction package CASE-0006/construction-2 (A区东轴线交通配套、照明与绿化工程包): traffic sign and marking materials, lighting luminaires and fittings, signal and monitoring embedded materials, and greening materials; delivery to site, quality certification documents, and warranty-period replacement are included. No construction, installation, temporary works or measure costs, and no construction interface responsibility. COMP-0154 submits written installation interface information to the buyer (COMP-0494) for the buyer's own installation; the buyer's construction-package quality acceptance records govern acceptance. Material costs remain included in the parent construction package contract price and are paid by COMP-0494 as buyer. Any scope change beyond these four categories remains unresolved and requires re-tendering.
negotiated_clauses.price_and_change_control: Total price 12,350,000 MOP, unchanged, with the bid breakdown preserved: traffic sign and marking materials 2,860,000 MOP (fixed), lighting luminaires and fittings 3,420,000 MOP (fixed), signal and monitoring embedded materials 1,980,000 MOP (fixed), greening materials 2,260,000 MOP (adjustable), transport and logistics 620,000 MOP, quality documents and warranty replacement risk allowance 780,000 MOP, supply management and commercial coordination 430,000 MOP. Before signing, COMP-0154 submits written supplier quotations or supply-intent evidence for the main sub-items of the three fixed-price categories; any fixed-price sub-item without such evidence is treated as a provisional estimate and adjusted to the verified quotation only with the buyer's prior written confirmation. Greening materials are adjustable against material price index 1.112 as baseline; the trigger conditions and calculation method are stated in writing in the contract, and no adjustment takes effect without the buyer's prior written confirmation. Fixed-price items carry the stated risk allowance and do not absorb index increases beyond it; no uncapped price adjustment is added to the authorized scope.
negotiated_clauses.payment_terms: Payment is made in batches against delivery, acceptance and payment per construction-package progress: each batch is paid only after the corresponding quality certification documents and the buyer's site acceptance record are provided, with the acceptance standard being COMP-0494's construction-package quality acceptance record. The warranty period for each batch starts from the date that batch passes acceptance. Payment nodes and acceptance standards are as set out in this clause and require no further document; COMP-0154 confirms them in writing after signing and on that basis locks its sub-supply and delivery commitments.
negotiated_clauses.delivery_and_review: Delivery milestones follow the construction-package schedule: after award COMP-0154 completes the supply plan and submits interface documents; the first batch of traffic sign, marking and embedded materials arrives at the construction-package start node; lighting luminaires arrive in installation batches; greening materials arrive within planting-season windows. Specific arrival dates are those confirmed in the supply milestones by COMP-0494 as construction-package contractor. Before the first delivery, COMP-0154 completes source and lead-time verification. Quality certification documents are submitted per category with each batch, with incoming inspection cooperation and warranty replacement response times as contract annex obligations; warranty replacement is handled by category from each batch's acceptance date.
negotiated_clauses.response_to_feedback: Buyer (COMP-0494) decisions now binding: batch delivery, batch acceptance and batch payment per construction-package progress, paid against quality documents and the buyer's acceptance record, warranty from each batch's acceptance date (feedback item 2 decided, no further document awaited). Accepted as stated risk allocation: the disclosed bid assumptions that sub-supply arrangements and alternative sources are not yet in place, and that fixed-price items carry index exposure within the stated allowance. Converted into obligations: pre-signing supplier quotation evidence for the three fixed-price categories, with unverified sub-items treated as provisional estimates adjusted only on the buyer's written confirmation (item 1); written trigger and calculation for the greening index-1.112 adjustment, effective only on the buyer's written confirmation (item 3); arrival dates per the buyer-confirmed supply milestones with source and lead-time verification before first delivery (item 4). COMP-0154's acceptance is noted. Price, currency, scope boundaries, parties, work shares and resource commitments are unchanged; no external documents or real-world approvals are claimed as reviewed or obtained, and future engineering deliverables remain binding obligations. Either party may reject this draft.
